sentry_events.description: WAISentry security events scored by AI triage for the fictional client Kitewing Software (synthetic, tokenised / zero-PII). One row per event that reached triage, 2026-10-08 to 2026-11-06 09:30. Routine raw records that never reached triage are only counted in sentry_ingest_daily.

columns.name: event_id
columns.description: Event id, e.g. EV-1101-A1 (incident events) or EV-1015-0042 (generated). Matches the triage tool's event ids for the three demo batches.

columns.name: event_ts
columns.description: Event time (UTC).

columns.name: event_local
columns.description: Event time in Kitewing local time (UTC-6). Use for local dates, hours and after-hours analysis.

columns.name: event_date
columns.description: Local date of the event.

columns.name: batch_id
columns.description: Telemetry batch id for the three demo batches (TB-1101-0200, TB-1028-1400, TB-1106-0900); NULL otherwise.

columns.name: source
columns.description: Telemetry source: workspace.login, workspace.token, workspace.drive, workspace.gmail, workspace.admin, mimecast, dnsfilter, knowbe4, web_proxy, edr, firewall_ids, syslog.dc, syslog.fs.

columns.name: category
columns.description: identity, oauth, email, data, endpoint, network, onprem or awareness.

columns.name: event_type
columns.description: Event type, e.g. oauth_grant, forwarding_rule_created, login_2sv_failed, session_replay, dns_block, credential_store_access.

columns.name: actor_token
columns.description: Who/what acted: a user token (USR-xxxx), device token (DEV-xxxx) or a server name (MB-*). Never a real name.

columns.name: summary
columns.description: Tokenised one-line description of the event.

columns.name: src_ip
columns.description: Source IP when relevant (documentation ranges; NULL otherwise).

columns.name: geo
columns.description: Geolocation of the source IP, e.g. 'Amsterdam, NL' (NULL when not relevant).

columns.name: signals
columns.description: Comma-separated triage signals, e.g. 'unverified_publisher,high_risk_scope'.

columns.name: triage_score
columns.description: AI triage score 0-99. Alerts are score >= 60.

columns.name: severity
columns.description: info (score < 60), medium (60-74), high (75-89), critical (90+).

columns.name: verdict
columns.description: noise (dropped by triage), alert (raised, not part of an incident) or incident (alert correlated into an incident).

columns.name: disposition
columns.description: For alerts: true_positive, true_positive_blocked, benign_true_positive or false_positive. NULL for noise.

columns.name: mitre_technique
columns.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique id, e.g. T1528 (NULL for noise without a technique).

columns.name: mitre_name
columns.description: ATT&CK technique name.

columns.name: mitre_tactic
columns.description: ATT&CK tactic, e.g. Credential Access.

columns.name: incident_id
columns.description: Incident id (joins sentry_incidents), also set on lower-score context events of an incident.

columns.name: after_hours
columns.description: True outside Mon-Fri 07:00-19:00 local time.

columns.name: triage_seconds
columns.description: Seconds from the event to the alert (alerts only).

sentry_incidents.description: WAISentry incidents for the fictional client Kitewing Software since go-live (2026-10-08 to 2026-11-06), with phase timings vs targets (triage 0-15 s, investigation 1-3 min, active containment < 60 s, first event to contained < 5 min). Synthetic, tokenised.

columns.name: incident_id
columns.description: Incident id, e.g. INC-1101-01. Joins sentry_events.incident_id.

columns.name: title
columns.description: Short incident title.

columns.name: category
columns.description: identity / OAuth / email, endpoint / identity, data exposure (Drive), email, identity, on-prem server, on-prem identity.

columns.name: severity
columns.description: medium, high or critical.

columns.name: status
columns.description: contained, resolved or open.

columns.name: primary_actor
columns.description: User token or host name at the centre of the incident.

columns.name: first_malicious_ts
columns.description: First malicious event (UTC).

columns.name: opened_local
columns.description: Incident opened, Kitewing local time (UTC-6).

columns.name: contained_local
columns.description: Contained (local time); NULL while open.

columns.name: contained_by
columns.description: pre-approved playbooks ..., escalation — ..., or preventive controls — ...

columns.name: triage_seconds
columns.description: First malicious event -> first alert.

columns.name: investigation_seconds
columns.description: Incident opened -> analyst confirmed.

columns.name: active_containment_seconds
columns.description: Authorisation -> last pre-approved playbook finished (NULL when no playbook ran).

columns.name: seconds_to_contain
columns.description: First malicious event -> contained (NULL while open).

columns.name: playbooks
columns.description: Comma-separated playbooks run (PB-01 session termination, PB-02 OAuth revocation, PB-03 suspension, PB-04 Drive quarantine).

columns.name: escalated_actions
columns.description: Number of actions escalated to the analyst/client (not pre-approved).

columns.name: analyst
columns.description: Certified Wursta analyst handle, e.g. A-17.

columns.name: mitre_techniques
columns.description: Comma-separated ATT&CK techniques on the attack path.

columns.name: funds_at_risk_usd
columns.description: Money at risk (e.g. a diverted vendor payment).

columns.name: funds_lost_usd
columns.description: Money lost.

columns.name: batch_id
columns.description: Telemetry batch that contains the incident, if any.

columns.name: outcome
columns.description: One-line outcome.

sentry_ingest_daily.description: WAISentry daily telemetry volume per source for the fictional client Kitewing Software (synthetic): raw records ingested in-tenant, events scored by AI triage, alerts and noise removed. 2026-10-08 to 2026-11-06 (the last day is partial, to 09:30).

columns.name: day
columns.description: Local date.

columns.name: source
columns.description: Telemetry source (same values as sentry_events.source).

columns.name: raw_records
columns.description: Raw telemetry records ingested by the in-tenant pipeline.

columns.name: events_scored
columns.description: Events passed to AI triage (rows in sentry_events).

columns.name: alerts
columns.description: Events raised as alerts (verdict alert or incident).

columns.name: noise_removed_pct
columns.description: 100 * (1 - alerts / events_scored); NULL when nothing was scored.
